messages.content: We need to add a nullable "region" column to the orders table and backfill it.

Plan: 1) add the nullable column in migration 0042, 2) backfill from customers.region in batches of 10,000, 3) add an index after the backfill, 4) prepare a rollback script. Migration 0042 is written and applied on staging.
Migration 0043 adds an index on orders.region; it was applied on staging without errors.
The staging backfill finished: 1,200,000 rows updated, 3 rows failed because customers.region was NULL. The rollback script has not been tested. What is the status?

required_facts: 3 rows failed because of NULL customers.region
